## Why Government Database Integration Is the Gold Standard for Background Checks in India


There are two fundamentally different ways to verify an employee’s background in India: **call people and hope they tell the truth** , or **query government databases that can’t be faked** .


Traditional background verification relies on calling previous employers, mailing universities, and sending field agents to verify addresses. This process takes **7 to 15 business days** , costs **₹500–₹2,000+ per candidate** , and is vulnerable to a simple exploit — candidates providing a friend’s phone number as their “former HR manager.”


**Government database integration** changes the equation entirely. When a background check platform queries government records directly — the Income Tax Department for PAN, EPFO for employment history, MoRTH’s VAHAN/SARATHI for driving licences, the Election Commission for Voter IDs — you get **verified records that candidates cannot fabricate, tamper with, or socially engineer** .


The numbers make the case. According to[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files H1 FY26](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) , **4.33% of white-collar hires** and **5.61% of gig workforce hires** in India have discrepancies in their background checks.[OnGrid’s FY 2024-25 Annual Report](https://www.ongrid.in/annual-report-fy-2024-25) found that **3.6 lakh individuals** had at least one background check failure during the year.

### Why Government Database Access Matters Here


The **UAN/EPFO past employment history** check is the most powerful government database integration available to Indian employers. Every formal employer in India contributes to an employee’s Provident Fund, creating a **government-maintained employment timeline** that:

- Shows **actual joining and exit dates** (not rounded or inflated)
- Shows **actual salary brackets** (not inflated for negotiation)
- Reveals **overlapping employers** (moonlighting detection)
- Exposes **hidden gaps** (employers the candidate didn’t mention)


No amount of social engineering can alter EPFO records. This makes it the single most fraud-proof employment verification method in India.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### 1. What does “government database integration” mean in background checks?


Government database integration means the background check platform queries official government records directly — such as the Income Tax Department for PAN verification, EPFO for employment history, MoRTH’s VAHAN/SARATHI for driving licences, and the Election Commission for Voter IDs — instead of relying on manual outreach to previous employers or universities.
